ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  360 ONE WAM LIMITED has successfully raised approximately INR 293.69 Crores by allotting 3.33 million equity shares to Mr. Saahil Murarka at Rs. 1,174.76 each, following the conversion of previously issued warrants. This transaction significantly increases the company's paid-up share capital by about 0.78% and results in a corresponding dilution for existing shareholders, without presenting any immediate red flags based on this standard regulatory disclosure.
